name: azure
description: Azure Pipelines templates that deliver a Distribution edition onto a Dynamicweb 10 host: one stage per environment, each a deployment job bound to an Azure DevOps Environment, running the deploy core.

proof.statement: The templates have not run in Azure DevOps yet. The script every step calls is pipelines/core, which has delivered base-only and swift-demo end to end; the YAML around it parses and is otherwise unmeasured.
